summary: Test-writing (red-phase) run for issue #5. Committed permanent tests that expose the missing generated-OpenAPI-client behavior: OpenAPISpecContractTests (13 tests validating the vendored document at iOS/Sources/OpenAPIGeneratedClient/openapi.json — currently failing because the spec is not vendored yet) and GeneratedClientStubbedResponseTests (7 tests exercising all six app surfaces through a stubbed ClientTransport — compiled out via #if canImport until the OpenAPIGeneratedClient target exists, with an XCTFail availability marker active now). Contract deltas between docs/color-matching-api-contract.md and the published spec (fetched and analyzed from viamin/color_matching PR #113) are recorded in docs/openapi-client-generation.md for the PR description. No Swift toolchain exists in this container, so swift test --disable-sandbox could not be executed locally; the red failures are expected to surface in CI (macOS). Implementation lands in the separate Paid implementation run after tests approval.
